MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including the last two focused mostly on CI/CD pipelines, test environments and build tooling. Owns GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and has built short-lived Kubernetes test environments with Helm. Personal infrastructure projects include a k3s cluster deployed with GitOps, monitoring and logging, and Terraform-provisioned infrastructure for a Hetzner VPS. Seeking to move into a DevOps or platform engineering role.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Infrastructure and delivery: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose, Helm, Terraform (personal project)
Kubernetes and GitOps: Kubernetes (namespace-level access and Helm test environments at work); k3s and Argo CD (personal project)
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki; Grafana dashboards for test metrics
Programming and data: Python, Bash, Java (test code), SQL, PostgreSQL
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Systems: Linux, Git; AWS EC2 and S3 basics (personal learning)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software, Wroclaw | 2021–Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (approximately 25 developers), covering build, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages, and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and separating end-to-end tests into their own stage; reduced monthly CI runner costs by about 30%.
- Built short-lived merge-request test environments with Docker Compose and later Helm on the company's shared Kubernetes cluster; environments run end-to-end tests and are automatically removed after merge or 48 hours of inactivity.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky-test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Wrote Bash and Python tooling for seeding PostgreSQL test data and created Grafana dashboards for flaky-test metrics.
- Wrote the internal guide to how CI works, which is used in team onboarding; mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House, Wroclaw | 2019–2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated testing.
- Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project.
- Configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018–2019
- Investigated customer issues in logs and databases and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024–2025
- Operated a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster, deploying applications from a Git repository with Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki for monitoring and logging, with Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health | 2023–2024
- Enabled each merge request to receive a short-lived environment for the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, deployed via Helm from GitLab CI to the shared Kubernetes cluster.
- Configured automatic cleanup after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; QA and product teams use the environments to review features before merge and run end-to-end tests.

EDUCATION
BEng, Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Studying for the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA); exam booked for January 2027.

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. My background combines seven years in QA automation with hands-on infrastructure work: I own CI pipelines for three product teams and have built Kubernetes-based environments that help teams validate and review changes before they merge.

At Odrava Health Software, I built merge-request environments deployed via Helm from GitLab CI, with PostgreSQL, seeded data, automated end-to-end tests and automatic cleanup. I also reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and lowered flaky-test rates from 7% to below 1%. These projects have given me practical experience improving delivery workflows, maintaining test infrastructure and making systems easier for development teams to use. I have also documented how CI works for onboarding and supported QA and product teams using the environments.

Alongside my production work, I built a three-node k3s homelab deployed through Argo CD, with Prometheus, Grafana and Loki, and used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS. My production Kubernetes work is scoped to namespace-level access and Helm-based test environments; the platform team operates the shared cluster. I am developing my infrastructure skills further through CKA study. I would bring this practical delivery and observability experience to Corvale's work connecting a new train fleet with cloud services, while continuing to grow into broader infrastructure ownership.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to the Fleet Connectivity team.

Marta Kowal-Brandt

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. My background combines seven years in QA automation with hands-on infrastructure work: I own CI pipelines for three product teams and have built Kubernetes-based environments that help teams validate and review changes before they merge.

At Odrava Health Software, I built merge-request environments deployed via Helm from GitLab CI, with PostgreSQL, seeded data, automated end-to-end tests and automatic cleanup. I also reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and lowered flaky-test rates from 7% to below 1%. These projects have given me practical experience improving delivery workflows, maintaining test infrastructure and making systems easier for development teams to use. I have also documented how CI works for onboarding and supported QA and product teams using the environments.

Alongside my production work, I built a three-node k3s homelab deployed through Argo CD, with Prometheus, Grafana and Loki, and used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS. My production Kubernetes work is scoped to namespace-level access and Helm-based test environments; the platform team operates the shared cluster. I am developing my infrastructure skills further through CKA study. I would bring this practical delivery and observability experience to Corvale's work connecting a new train fleet with cloud services, while continuing to grow into broader infrastructure ownership.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to the Fleet Connectivity team.

Marta Kowal-Brandt
